ops.title: Prefer configured repository Trunk SSM credentials over implicit Keychain
ops.description: Concurrent PR573 introduced env→globalDarwinKeychain→configuredSSM, allowing an implicit stale or different-org Keychain item to shadow the explicitly configured repository credential source. Root ruling restores env→configuredSSM (including visible config/lookup failures)→Keychain only when no repo SSM. Preserve zero-PR queue-read skip and generic unconfigured-repo Keychain support. Implement only the existing selection reorder plus behavior fixtures; no key reads, broad revert, new resolver framework, or auth-error queue fallback.

ops.text: Configured SSM wins over a valid Keychain token; invalid configuration and lookup failure stay errors without Keychain fallback
Environment token still wins and unconfigured-repository Keychain remains functional; zero-PR queue skip unchanged
Exact source independently reviewed, required CI green, normally merged and officially released with native593+581+588
Official installed CLI and real needed publisher operation prove the intended credential/native contract without protected process changes
